preservedResponsibilities: Original uno::Type one-pointer value declarations in Type.h and exact inline member bodies in Type.hxx are bound into a single actual Type class; JavaScript class member definition requires one owner, not a substitute constructor/prototype patch or second class. Default VOID reads the actual static cache cell and acquires once. Exact class/OUString and terminated ASCII overloads reuse real C factories and shared SAL strings. Pointer and copy constructors acquire; both no-acquire enum tags transfer the pointer without acquisition. Native rvalue construction selects the original copy constructor; there is no move constructor. Explicit dispose maps the unconditional original destructor. Copy assignment reuses original acquire-before-release/self-identity logic; move assignment swaps both pointers and returns this. Acquired names, borrowed getTypeLibType, output replacement description, original class cast/equality operators/compatibility delegate to existing shared owners. The actual CPPU header imports the generated UDK TypeClass enum; original dependency direction is retained without a reverse edge. Complete original normal and sanitized native calls and portable replay compare initialized counts/names/common fields and all15 basic Type value pairs. Deliberately null no-acquire values are retained without destruction and observed only through valid nullable pointer/predicate methods. Physical SAL new/delete operators/ABI, const and rvalue enforcement, Array/legacy/UnoType templates, native threading/shutdown and full Any/Reference/default RuntimeException/case/UI consumers remain unverified; system libraries are uninstrumented and leak detection is disabled. No original body/method is substituted and broad parity flags stay false.
